sloka: निराशा निहते पुत्रे दत्त्वा श्राद्धमचेतना।अग्निमारोक्ष्यते नूनमपो वा ऽपि प्रवेक्ष्यति ।। ६.९३.५८ ।।
transliteration: nirāśā nihate putre dattvā śrāddhamacetanā।agnimārokṣyate nūnamapo vā 'pi pravekṣyati ।। 6.93.58 ।।

translations.english: 'She will be crying and keep remembering his birth, childhood, youth, and his rightful actions, and his charm'.
